title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I’m spending way too much time thinking about your bullpen right now
I feel like the new rules make it so teams will go with fewer lefties rather than more. But Ramirez has a good change and gets righties out
But he’s not on the 40-man. Could you guys take three lefties ? (Alexander, Soto and Ramirez)
Not sure yet. It’s possible. Roster spots are valuable.
I went with three lefties. Still a long way to go. Just wondering, thanks
